prompt:
﻿# genui_gen_v4_compact

You are a GenUICraft generator.
Convert the RESPONSE text into valid GenUICraft v0.9 server-to-client messages.

RESPONSE:
Assumptions:
- The mobile UI is designed for a standard portrait mode screen.
- A clean, minimalist aesthetic is prioritized for ease of use.
- The default screen displayed upon app launch is the 'Scan' screen.

UI Layout Description:

Screen Title: QR Scanner

Top Section:
  Flash Toggle: Positioned in the top right corner of the viewfinder area. This will be an icon representing a lightning bolt. Tapping it will toggle the camera flash on or off, with the icon changing state (e.g., filled for on, outlined for off).
  Gallery Upload Button: Located in the top left corner of the viewfinder area. This will be an icon representing a picture or photo album. Tapping it will open the device's image gallery for selecting a QR code image to scan.

Middle Section:
  Scanning Viewfinder: This occupies the majority of the screen's central area. It is represented by a transparent square or rectangle with slightly rounded corners, serving as an overlay on the live camera feed. This area clearly indicates where the user should align the QR code for scanning. A subtle text instruction like "Align QR code within the frame" may be displayed.

Bottom Navigation Bar:
  A persistent navigation bar is placed at the very bottom of the screen. It contains three distinct, equally spaced icons, each with a text label directly below it. The 'Scan' icon will be highlighted to indicate the active screen.
  - Scan: Represents the primary QR code scanning function.
  - History: Navigates to a screen displaying a log of previously scanned QR codes.
  - Settings: Navigates to a screen for application configurations and preferences.

Icons:
- Flash On: (e.g., a filled lightning bolt icon)
- Flash Off: (e.g., an outlined lightning bolt icon)
- Gallery Upload: (e.g., an image or photo library icon)
- Scan (Active): (e.g., a filled QR code scanner icon or camera icon)
- History: (e.g., an hourglass or a list icon)
- Settings: (e.g., a cogwheel icon)

Output contract:
- Output ONLY a JSON array (no markdown, no prose).
- Each array item must be one v0.9 message object.
- Allowed message types only: `createSurface`, `updateComponents`, `updateDataModel`, `deleteSurface`.
- Add `createSurface` before any updates.
- `createSurface.catalogId` must be `https://genui.local/specification/v0_9/standard_catalog.json`.
- Include exactly one `updateComponents` message with a complete component set.
- In that set, include exactly one component with `id: "root"` as tree root.
- Component ids must be unique; all child references must resolve.
- Use only catalog-supported components and properties.

Component guidance:
- Prefer structured UI over text dumps.
- Use `Card`, `Row`, `Column`, `List`, `Tabs`, `Divider`, `Button` where appropriate.
- Convert action-like links/"Quick Actions" to `Button` with `action.functionCall.call = "openUrl"`.
- Preserve key content (assumptions, options, comparisons, totals, sources) without hallucination.
- If dynamic rows are useful, use `updateDataModel` + template children binding.

Assets and URLs:
- For media, use only local asset paths that start with `/`.
- Never output remote image/icon URLs.
- For web actions, `openUrl` targets may be remote URLs.

Validation reminders:
- `version` must be `"v0.9"` on every message.
- `updateComponents.components` must be a non-empty array.
- Keep JSON strictly valid.
